HRA Analysis: BITTA IRISH LUCK (6) has won two out of her last three starts. She ran second last start behind an impressive HAYOAK after facing the breeze. She finds an easier race today and she should be hard to beat. GEORGY GIRL (5) returns from a break. If she is anywhere near her best then she should be able to feature in a race like this. IMA DESTROYER (1) and DOUBLE JOEY (3) are also chances.

TREACHEROUS BREW (4) has shown plenty of ability at the trials. His stable and driver must be respected in a race like this. He looks like the one to beat. SAL WESTER (6) looks like the main danger after putting together some impressive runs at Port Pirie. SIENNA BELLA (7) and JUST MILZY (1) are also chances.

OAKHAY (7) ran a better race last start at Port Pirie when he ran second behind NITEONTHETOWN and was beaten by 3.1 meters. He should get a great run through from the inside of the second row. He will be hard to beat today. SHIREEN (1), OUR CHEEKY DEVIL (4) and TAKE MY WALLET (8) are also chances.

ALWAYSBEALADY (5) ran second behind HEZ SO ROYAL last start and she was only beaten by a head. Today is a lot easier for her and if she can repeat that effort then she should be hard to beat. BITOFDUTCHCOURAGE (7), HASTY BID (8) and PER ARDUA AD ASTRA (6) are also chances.

BERSAGLIERE (2) returns from a spell today. He has shown patches of ability in the early stages of his career. He is a good chance of finding the lead today and if he leads then he should be hard to catch. KEAYANG MEMORY (7) looks like the main danger after an impressive win last start. She will be right in the finish today. OUR PRINCESS DI (6) and THE CAPTAINESS (1) are also chances.

BLINGADINGDING (8) has been knocking on the door without winning. He finds a very winnable race and he looks like the stand out in a race where there isn’t a lot of form to go off. CLARENDEN ARCADIA (9), LOVE OF THE SEA (2) and BROBENAH GIRL (7) are also chances.

An extremely tricky race where any horse could win. DOUBLE JOEY (7) will be dangerous if she gains a start as the emergency. OMNIA (4) is first up from a spell but she showed plenty of ability during her first season as a two year old. She defeated HELPISFARAWAY by 2 meters in the Southern Cross final last start in December. She will be right in the finish if she can improve off her first preparation. JILLIBY BLISS (11), HELPISFARAWAY (1) and ALDEBARAN BREE (8) are also chances.

GOLDEN JAYLET (3) has a great record here at Gawler and he is well drawn to be on the pace today which he will enjoy. He will be a big improver today. PARADIGM (6), LOCHINVAR RULER (5) and AMYS BABY ANGEL (4) are also chances.

LARDY DAH LADY (6) has the tricky draw to overcome but today does look a little easier for her. If she is at her best and receives the right drive into the race then she will be a strong chance. ELLA KATE (11), LIGHTNING BLING (4) and MURRA LANE (2) are also chances. Harness.org.au Help Privacy Advertise Terms Of Use Contact Us © Racing Information Services Enterprise 2026 Powered by

OVERVIEW:WAR ZONE (6) was very aggressively driven after commencing from the second row and peaked late when ninth at Melton last outing. He was a big winner at Melton on July 24 when he led throughout in a mile rate of 1.55.3 and he is a good chance of finding the lead again here so a bold showing is expected. BETTORSWEETVICTORY (9) raced without cover throughout and battled on well for fifth behind Madam Reactor at Shepparton eight days ago. She follows out behind a fast beginner and should gain an economical trip so she looms as one of the leading chances. SKYZ ABOVE (3) won twice in succession at Ballarat prior to an eighth behind Know The Score, where he was picking up ground from last. He is much better drawn than last week and is worth another chance. MIDNIGHT MOJO (7) has a tough draw to overcome but she is usually competitive against this class and could show up without surprising. SELECTIONS: WAR ZONE (6), BETTORSWEETVICTORY (9), SKYZ ABOVE (3), MIDNIGHT MOJO (7)

OVERVIEW:CO CAPTAIN (5) returns to Victoria after a Queensland campaign, where he took out the Derby/Qaks Consolation at his latest performance. He won a trial after dashing home in a last quarter of 27.3 seconds at Melton last week and he should prove hard to beat again. COVERED IN GOLD (9) has won three of his past four starts and looms as a danger to his stable mate. He finished off smartly to score in a slick mile rate of 1.54.9 at Shepparton last outing. ONE GOLDEN DEAL (7) is an interesting runner. She hasn’t started since beating a strong field at Horsham in May and hasn’t been to the trials. She recorded a mile rate of 1.54.7 at Melton in April so she has the speed to test this field. BETTOR PUNTER (4) is racing in peak form and has claims along with VINNY ROCK (2) and LET’S GO LORNA (6), which beat the smart pacer Secret Service Agent (won since) at her latest victory. BACK: CO CAPTAIN (5) – 3 units (win) SELECTIONS: CO CAPTAIN (5), COVERED IN GOLD (9), ONE GOLDEN DEAL (7), LET’S GO LORNA (6)

OVERVIEW: BINALONG MATE (5) is stepping up in class from his latest Melton victory but he did score impressively and his overall form is strong. He is a versatile pacer and is capable of taking the next step forward. OUT TO STAY (1) has been a little below his best form since resuming but his latest fourth after working hard at Hamilton was encouraging and he has the class to test this field if he can hold a forward position at the start. ALLGOOD VINNIE (3) holds the key to the event. He is a brilliant beginner and has won twice recently after leading out then taking cover so he is likely to try and adopt similar tactics here. ROCKELLA (4) was caught wide early and dropped back to a rearward position so he didn’t have much luck at his latest unplaced run. He was held up for a run and should have finished closer when fourth prior so he is racing better than his form reads. SELECTIONS: BINALONG MATE (5), OUT TO STAY (1), ALLGOOD VINNIE (3), ROCKELLA (4)

OVERVIEW: IM EDDIE (3) is a strong type, which worked forward to find the lead and battled on gamely for a close second at Ballarat last outing. He is a good chance of finding the lead again and is capable of going one better. CONSTANT (1) lacks early dash and is likely to be headed off the start but his first up second was encouraging as he hit the line strongly. METRO SWISH (4) appeared to have her chance after setting up a slow tempo in the lead at her latest third but she has been placed in four of her past five starts and she is drawn to gain a prominent position again. BLACKRANGE GLORY (8) is a very smart horse when he is able to put it altogether and is a winning chance if he delivers a fool proof display. He has been freshened after missing away from the standing start and finishing unplaced at Horsham last outing. SELECTIONS: IM EDDIE (3), CONSTANT (1), METRO SWISH (4), BLACKRANGE GLORY (8)

OVERVIEW:COOL STORY (8) was held up for a run at a vital stage and stormed home for an eye-catching second at Melton then finished off stoutly in quick final sectionals at his latest fifth. He is racing in top form and strikes a suitable assignment so he is likely to be confidently supported. The interesting runner is STORM VENDETTA (4). He produced a career best performance to win in a mile rate of 1.56.0 at the end of last season then was sent to Tasmania but didn’t fire in four attempts. He returns to Victoria and has the early speed to be prominent throughout. ROYAL ROCKSTAR (6) is a fast beginner and was able to break through for a win after leading throughout at Ballarat. He is stepping up in class for this assignment but should go well again. YANKEE MOJOH (3) and BUNGY (7) are both worth thought in multiple combinations. BACK: COOL STORY (8) – 4 units (wIn) SELECTIONS: COOL STORY (8), STORM VENDETTA (4), ROYAL ROCKSTAR (6), BUNGY (7)

OVERVIEW:ESPERANZA (8) appeared to have every chance after gaining the one out and one back trail when sixth behind Spun Silver at Melton last outing but she will appreciate a slight drop back in grade and has the services of ace reinsman James Herbertson so she is worth another chance. ATOMIC GLORY (5) is a good chance of finding the lead shortly after the start and was runner up in a race of similar standard at Cranbourne two starts ago so he warrants respect. He didn’t enjoy the best of luck at his latest unplaced run behind Final Bow, where he worked hard in the run. THE FEENY FAVORITE (7) went forward from a similar wide draw and battled on well for third at Melton last week. He is an experienced maiden but this is no harder than his latest handy performance. SILVER DOMINO (1) was safely held when resuming but he has been competitive against stronger opposition previously and he should be fitter this time around. SELECTIONS: ESPERANZA (8), ATOMIC GLORY (5), THE FEENY FAVORITE (7), SILVER DOMINO (1)

OVERVIEW: JOE LOU (6) has been in fine form having won three of his past four starts including an incredible victory at Melton on July 15, where he broke stride early and came from tailed off. He worked forward to find the lead and scored comfortably at Melton last outing so there is no reason why he can’t win again. SHAQ THE ANVIL (4) will appreciate a drop back in class for this assignment and had no luck after being checked at the 400m mark when unplaced at Melton last outing. He finished third behind the in-form trotter Spirited Lass prior and he looms as a strong winning chance. SNICKERS EXPRESS (5) is working into some form with placed efforts behind Rastamon and Off Your Faceski at his past two starts. He should gain a nice trail just off the speed and is not without a chance. WHATS THE TEA (7) and I AM SKYE CHIOLA (8) are both racing well enough to figure in the finish. SELECTIONS: JOE LOU (6), SHAQ THE ANVIL (4), SNICKERS EXPRESS (5), WHATS THE TEA (7)

OVERVIEW: SHONEE (3) is a promising trotter, which has been placed in all of her four starts since resuming from a spell. She led out then took cover and chased hard when second behind the smart type Keayang Tweetybird at Terang last outing and is capable of going one better here. CHAMPAGNES (2) continues her impressive form line having won four of her past five starts. She led throughout and scored by a large margin, seemingly with plenty in reserve at Kilmore last outing. This is a race of more depth but she should prove hard to beat again. NO TELLING HEATHER (1) was runner up behind CHAMPAGNES (2) at her last attempt and is perfectly drawn to run a good race again. VANCE LANE (6) pushed forward to find the lead and was run down late in handy time when resuming. He has struck trouble in three efforts since and has claims if he puts in a fool proof display. BACK: SHONEE (3) – 1.5 units (each way) SELECTIONS: SHONEE (3), CHAMPAGNES (2), NO TELLING HEATHER (1), VANCE LANE (6)

OVERVIEW: FREMARKS ELITE (3) is making his debut for trainer Courtney Slater and shaped up nicely at a Melton trial effort last week, where he was beaten by a narrow margin in reasonable time. He obviously has ability and is worth following. THE TROUT COD (5) was resuming since April and having his first run for trainer Ross Graham when a handy third at Shepparton last outing. She should be fitter from that run and is worth an investment. THE PASO DOBLE (2) has been placed in four out of his past five starts and should give another honest account. He possesses early speed and finished second after trailing the leader throughout last outing. ALCOMBZ (6) has ability but is still learning. He was slow to begin and had excuses last time and finished third behind Pique at Ballarat prior. SELECTIONS: FREMARKS ELITE (3), THE TROUT COD (5), THE PASO DOBLE (2), ALCOMBZ (6)

OVERVIEW:IMALLATTITUDE (5) finished off best to defeat Foregone Conclusion (won since) at Ballarat then followed with a narrow second at Hamilton, where he sustained a flat tyre and probably should have won again. He is racing in career best form and should prove hard to beat under these conditions. KIMCHI (4) appeared to have every chance after leading when fourth at Ballarat last outing but he was placed at his four starts prior including a Maryborough victory, where he led throughout so he is worth an investment. TORQUE IN HEAVEN (3) commenced from the second line, settled midfield and made ground in the final 600m when third at Hamilton last outing. He is racing consistently and should go well again. CELESTIAL NEBULAE (6) attempted to lead throughout at his first run since November and ended up finishing in fifth. He should be fitter from that performance and is not without a chance. BACK: IMALLATTITUDE (5) – 1.5 units (each way) SELECTIONS: IMALLATTITUDE (5), KIMCHI (4), TORQUE IN HEAVEN (3), CELESTIAL NEBULAE (6)

OVERVIEW:HUXHAM CHUBB (5) settled in a rearward position, made a run out three horses wide at the 800m mark, gained a slight breather approaching the quarter pole and came wide again over the latter stages when a creditable second at Hamilton last week. She was held up behind a tiring runner when fourth at Maryborough prior and she is nearing a win against this class. OVER THE LINE (6) is resuming since a third at Maryborough in May. He only had four starts last preparation and he lacks solid racing but he did shape up nicely during his last term so he cannot be underestimated. MARGARITARI (4) settled four back on the markers and angled out very wide on the home turn when third at Hamilton last outing. He is racing consistently and is worth an investment. RAVISHING ROXY (2) is a 2yo filly taking on older horses but she is a fast beginner and should be fitter after her first up performance so a forward showing would not surprise. SELECTIONS: HUXHAM CHUBB (5), OVER THE LINE (6), MARGARITARI (4), RAVISHING ROXY (2)

OVERVIEW: It is a tough race to assess with most of the horses being inexperienced. DANCE DANCE DANCE (7) is a juvenile debutante for trainer Zac Steenhuis with ace reinsman James Herbertson aboard. He has shaped up nicely at the trials with his latest effort being a second behind Majestic Charma so he sure to attract plenty of support. His stable mate BROTHER THOMAS (5) has also performed well at the trials having been placed twice and should go well on debut. WHY NOW (4) gained a nice trail but he chased hard when second behind Rama Saigo at his first up run. He should have benefited from the experience and is worth an investment. GREAT HORIZON (2) appeared to have her chance last outing but she hasn’t finished further back than fourth in six starts during her current preparation and is drawn to run her usual honest race. SELECTIONS: DANCE DANCE DANCE (7), BROTHER THOMAS (5), WHY NOW (4), GREAT HORIZON (2)

OVERVIEW: SOHO AMARYLLIS (8) is resuming since a victory in slick time at Shepparton in June and hasn’t been to the trials. She will probably end up being three back on the markers from her awkward trailing draw but she is a handy filly and should be dashing home late. CELESTIAL ZODIAC (9) will appreciate a significant drop back in class for this assignment and is better than his form suggests. He didn’t have much room in the straight and should have finished closer than fourth at his latest performance. EYESEALITTLE (6) sustained a flat tyre and had excuses at her latest eighth. She won at Charlton in July and finished off well when fourth behind Jilliby Sniper two starts ago so she cannot be discarded. SPORTING RAGE (1) performs well on his local track and is suited over the sprint distance. He was very wide from the 400m at his latest creditable fifth and led throughout at a Charlton victory in July. BACK: SOHO AMARYLLIS (8) – 1 unit (each way) SELECTIONS: SOHO AMARYLLIS (8), CELESTIAL ZODIAC (9), EYESEALITTLE (6), SPORTING RAGE (1)

OVERVIEW:BANGBANG BOBBIE (11) broke stride at the start and was a clear last early before making ground for a handy fifth at his debut. He obviously has ability and strikes a suitable assignment now so he warrants respect. PHILS BOY (8) is a juvenile taking on older horses but he is nicely bred and has shown ability in several trial campaigns so a bold showing would not surprise. JUST LIKE NUGGET (2) is an experienced Maiden but he has only missed a top four spot twice at his past seven attempts so he is racing consistently. BETTING ATTACK (3) has performed below expectations at his past three starts but he was runner up at his previous two attempts and his early speed should put him into a prominent position in the early stages of the event. BACK: BANGBANG BOBBIE (11) – 1.5 units (each way) SELECTIONS: BANGBANG BOBBIE (11), PHILS BOY (8), JUST LIKE NUGGET (2), BETTING ATTACK (3)

OVERVIEW:EYENEEDTHAT (10) didn’t really fire after returning from a tilt at the New South Wales Derby last preparation but he was taking on strong opposition. This is a significant drop back in class and he is a smart horse when racing at his peak so a bold showing is expected first up. HUNGRY HOGARTH (2) broke stride at the start and was a clear last early then got held up badly behind tiring runners so he was very unlucky at Mildura last week. He is a tough type and is trained on the track so he is sure to make his presence felt. METRO MEMORY (1) is a fast beginner and has been racing consistently against similar grade. He led throughout at a Maryborough victory on June 29 so he should go well from the pole position. MILOLA ROCK (4) is rising in class on her latest victory but she has been impressive in two starts since coming from New South Wales so she cannot be dismissed. SELECTIONS: EYENEEDTHAT (10), HUNGRY HOGARTH (2), METRO MEMORY (1), MILOLA ROCK (4)

OVERVIEW: It is a very fast front line and a genuine early tempo will suit CAPTAIN PINS (10) and the others drawn on the back row. CAPTAIN PINS (10) will appreciate a huge drop back in class for this assignment and wasn’t beaten by far in fast time at a Melton trial last week so he can return to peak form. SAVON DE ROCHE (8) has been very impressive in three starts since resuming but she will need a little luck from the inside of the second line. She sustained a long run from the 600m mark when a brave third behind Keayang Viper at Hamilton last week. SCOOTER LOU (1) is a smart 3yo pacer, which is resuming since a sixth at Melton in May. He possesses early speed but he has several blistering beginners drawn on his outside so he might have to work hard to hold a forward position early. GOODTIME LIBBY (9) was safely held at her first run since returning from New South Wales but she was placed at Menangle in a sensational mile of 1.48.6 during her Sydney trip so she is capable of better. RANGER RICK (6) continues his consistent form and ALL BLAZING GUNS (7) was making ground out wide on the track in a leader dominated race at Hamilton last outing. BACK: CAPTAIN PINS (10) – 1 unit (each way) SELECTIONS: CAPTAIN PINS (10), SAVON DE ROCHE (8), SCOOTER LOU (1), GOODTIME LIBBY (9)

OVERVIEW:ALDEBARAN JAZMINE (5) has been freshened since a disappointing seventh at Kilmore in July. Her form prior was strong and she will take beating if she can return to her peak form. THE ITALIAN DREAM (6) finished off nicely when fourth behind BUSLIN BRODY (8) at Kilmore last week. She is trotting consistently and should be competitive again. BUSLIN BRODY (8) settled three back on the markers and finished off best via the sprint lane when he scored at Kilmore last week. He is awkwardly drawn on the inside of the second line but this is a field of similar quality so he must be considered as a winning chance again. CLASSIC FAIR (10) galloped and lost his chance when resuming but he finished a close second behind Little Miss Morgan at a Cobram trial since so he is capable of better. TWEEDLEDEE (9) settled four back on the markers and burst home late when a game second behind Vici Bloom at Melton last week. He hasn’t won in 39 starts for the season but he appears to be very well graded with a claiming price of $8,000 in this event so he cannot be discarded. SELECTIONS: ALDEBARAN JAZMINE (5), THE ITALIAN DREAM (6), BUSLIN BRODY (8), CLASSIC FAIR (10)

OVERVIEW:BET BET HOTSHOT (1) was headed off at the start and ended up being three back on the markers before finishing off well for second behind FLING IT RAINBOW (7) last week. He might end up being behind the leader here and will be dangerous via the sprint lane. PIQUE (9) made several errors and lost her chance when unplaced at Kilmore last outing. She ran a game race when second behind Keayang Minnesota at Ballarat prior and she was runner up behind the classy 2yo trotter Phoenix Red on July 24 so she is worth another chance. AGAINST THE BRIDLE (8) pushed forward to race without cover and faded into seventh at Kilmore last outing. His form prior was sound and this is a drop back in class so he is worth an investment. FLING IT RAINBOW (7) began quickly and ended up being behind the leader when he got home best to win at Kilmore last week. He has a tough draw to overcome but he won comfortably last time out. SELECTIONS: BET BET HOTSHOT (1), PIQUE (9), AGAINST THE BRIDLE (8), FLING IT RAINBOW (7)

OVERVIEW: STERLING GIGI (6) began quickly but ended up being shuffled to three back on the markers when he chased hard for second behind Kings Gallery at Melton last week. He has shown promise during his juvenile season and this appears to be a very suitable assignment. JUST MY LUCK (7) is resuming but won a trial in reasonable time at Cobram last week and is capable of showing up without surprising. ROCKINTHEKASBA (8) had every chance and dropped out from the 400m when ninth on this track at his first run since April. He performed much better in a trial prior with a runaway success so an improved showing would not surprise. DONTTELLNANNA (9) settled in a rearward position and did well over the final 200m to pick up half of the field at Cranbourne on Sunday. She is better than her form reads and rates as a value hope. ASHANTE CADMAN (5) led out then took cover when second behind Beau Beca last week. He is likely to adopt similar tactics here and is worth a ticket each way. BACK: STERLING GIGI (6) – 3 units (win) SELECTIONS: STERLING GIGI (6), JUST MY LUCK (7), ROCKINTHEKASBA (8), DONTTELLNANNA (9)

OVERVIEW: KINGS GALLERY (10) is a very smart juvenile pacer, which was runner up at his first four attempts and resumed with a dominant victory at Melton last week. He is taking on older horses this evening but he appears to have a very promising future. BLUE MIKI (7) circled around the field from the middle of the pack to race without cover and battled on strongly for second behind Hez Harrywho seven days ago. He is versatile and is racing consistently so he looms as one of the leading chances again. TOOBY GOLD (6) commenced from the inside of the second line and was shuffled back to seventh early before finishing off fast for an eye-catching second behind Spun Silver last week. This race is slightly tougher but she is capable of running into a place again. MIKI MARK (8) was also caught on the markers after commencing from the inside of the second line last week and didn’t have much luck. He is racing well and is worth thought in multiple combinations. BACK: KINGS GALLERY (10) – 4 units (win) SELECTIONS: KINGS GALLERY (10), BLUE MIKI (7), TOOBY GOLD (6), MIKI MARK (8)

OVERVIEW:THESTING (6) is resuming since January but he has had four recent trial performances so he should be somewhere near his peak fitness. His four race track starts to date were in the Homegrown Classic series, the Graham Head Memorial and the Holloway Classic so he appears to be well placed against this field. ARCHAA (3) is a fast beginner and has been racing in fine form at Kilmore with four wins and three placed efforts from his past seven starts. He attempted to lead throughout and ran along at a genuine tempo when third behind Shazza Love seven days ago. LIBERTY STAR DUST (8) settled in the second half of the field and produced a big finish when a game third at his first run since May. He has ability and is worth following. UNCLE TREV (5) was held up for a run at a vital stage and finished off nicely for third behind Madam Reactor at Shepparton last week. That was his first up run since June and he should strip fitter so he must be included amongst the leading chances. FROSTY DROP (7) led throughout at a Cranbourne victory on June 14 and met a strong field at her latest sixth. She is poorly drawn but has the ability to figure in the finish. BACK: THESTING (6) – 1 unit (win) SELECTIONS: THESTING (6), ARCHAA (3), LIBERTY STAR DUST (8), UNCLE TREV (5)

OVERVIEW:PASS THE SALT (5) was resuming since a sixth in the Homegrown Classic in December when he raced without cover throughout and proved to be too strong at Kilmore last week. He should strip fitter from that performance and is a winning chance again despite rising in class. OX KNOX (6) was heavily supported and led throughout to score comfortably over Buslin Brody (won since) at Melton. He has returned from a break in good form and should prove hard to beat again. CALL ME JACK (7) will appreciate a drop back in grade from his recent efforts and he is capable of sprinting to the line quickly with the right trail forward. He is likely to settle in a rearward position early but will be suited if there is a genuine tempo throughout. STRAIGHT TO THETOP (4) is a speedy mare that finished a close second last week after leading out then taking cover. She is likely to adopt similar tactics here and has winning claims. SELECTIONS: PASS THE SALT (5), OX KNOW (6), CALL ME JACK (7), STRAIGHT TO THETOP (4)

OVERVIEW: MOISSANITE (7) is still learning and has gait issues but he has the ability to test this field. He was slow to begin and lost approximately 30m before circling around the field to race without cover when a big third behind Callinan at Ballarat. MI BOW (5) was checked at the start and lost several lengths before settling at the back of the pack then sustained a long run from the 800m when a creditable third last outing. She has been placed in five of her past six starts and deserves to break through for a win. LEZAMA (4) gained a nice trail early and was left stranded without cover from the bell when second behind Sambezia last outing. She has also been racing consistently with four placed efforts from her past five starts and warrants respect. DELTA GEE (1) is a first starter for trainer Kari Males, which finished third at a Kilmore trial effort last week and must be kept safe. BACK: MOISSANITE (7) – 1 unit (each way) SELECTIONS: MOISSANITE (7), MI BOW (5), LEZAMA (4), DELTA GEE (1)

DOCTA FEELGOOD (1) has the gate speed to lead in this race and generally does his best work out in front. He was forced to race without cover last time out and battled on well for seventh not beaten too far behind Western Bill. STUDLEIGH MARK (7) should get a good run through on the back of the likely leader in this race. Led last time out before handing over to Queen Lilibet before running second last time out. He should get every chance. SHES IN LINE (4) led last time out at Marburg kicking strongly before being run down in the concluding stages by Dual Cam who had the perfect run on her back. She draws a touch awkwardly in this race but should settle close and can run well. SPLASHNDASH (5) looks well graded in this race but does draw wide. He was shuffled back last time out at Marburg and couldn’t get into that race late. SELECTIONS: DOCTA FEELGOOD (1), STUDLEIGH MARK (7), SHES IN LINE (4), SPLASHNDASH (5) SUGGESTED BET: DOCTA FEELGOOD (1) to win.

THREENTWO (1) has good gate speed and seems to love leading in her races. She led three starts ago and was run down late by Major Orion before being beaten by Champagne Walsh both horses which would likely be short priced favourites in this race. ART OF ROCK (5) got back in the run last time out and was working through the line well in the concluding stages in a race taken out by Francs For Coming. He is likely to find this race a touch easier but does draw poorly. CHARLIE CHUCKLES (7) should get a good run through in the early stages of this race. He secured a good run off the speed last time out and was running on well late to score. He steps up in grade but does have a good draw to offset that. TAKE COURAGE (3) battled on well for third last time out behind Candykane at this track in what was seemingly a stronger race. She should get a good run off the speed and can be running on late. SELECTIONS: THREENTWO (1), ART OF ROCK (5), CHARLIE CHUCKLES (7), TAKE COURAGE (3) SUGGESTED BET: THREENTWO (1) to win.

PENNIE PACKER (8) should get a good run off the speed in this race and does appear the class runner in the field. She secured a good run leaders back two starts ago and was able to run a very good second behind Art Jester who led all the way. TAYLORS FOUR (1) has no gate speed which could see her shuffled back in the early stages of this race. She drew wide last time out at Marburg when shuffled back and ran on fairly into sixth. ROCKTIME (9) should get a good run off the speed in this race and looks suited in this company. He was a winner five starts ago when sitting without cover at Marburg and proving too good there. TURBO TOMMY (7) draws a touch awkwardly inside the back row which could see him shuffled back early. Drew the back row last time out at this track and was running on nicely late into seventh when not beaten too far by Theresachance. SELECTIONS: PENNIE PACKER (8), TAYLORS FOUR (1), ROCKTIME (9), TURBO TOMMY (7) SUGGESTED BET: PENNIE PACKER (8) to win.

ROCKNROLL DA GAMA (5) drew outside the back row last time out at Marburg and was running on late into sixth behind The Casual Goose. He may be shuffled back again in this race and should be finishing it off strongly. MILLIONDOLLAR KISS (6) secured a good run two starts ago behind the leader and battled on well for fourth behind Art Of Rock. She appears to find an easier race and should run well. ILLBEWATCHING (8) got a good run off the speed last time out at this track and was running on late into fourth. He finds a race where there could be a genuine early tempo and could be running into it late. SAMMYS SECRET (3) has good gate speed and should be able to find a prominent position in this race. If he can work to the lead he would likely be hard to run down. SELECTIONS: ROCKNROLL DA GAMA (5), MILLIONDOLLAR KISS (6), ILLBEWATCHING (8), SAMMYS SECRET (3) SUGGESTED BET: ROCKNROLL DA GAMA (5) to win.

MY ULTIMATE LOUIE (3) is usually a good front runner and appears to find a race where he could work to the lead in the early stages. He had little luck last time out when doing plenty of work in the run before copping a flat tyre. MADAM WEST (8) was well beaten last time out but may not have been suited in a race which became a dash home taken out by La Bomba. She should be better suited if there is a more genuine tempo this time. ROSEANNE RUBY (9) was able to lead at Marburg when run down late by Wicked Mack. She should get a good run off the speed in this race and can be running on late. DOOLITTLE DOOZZIE (5) secured a good run off the speed last time out and was running on late into fifth. She draws wide but looks well graded in this race. SELECTIONS: MY ULTIMATE LOUIE (3), MADAM WEST (8), ROSEANNE RUBY (9), DOOLITTLE DOOZZIE (5) SUGGESTED BET: MY ULTIMATE LOUIE (3) to win.

ROCKS OR DIAMONDS (6) is the clear standout on class in this race but does draw widest in this race. He was well beaten last time out behind Smarter Than You and Braventreacheorus but should find this race a lot easier. FOXFIRE EASTON (5) secured a good run off the speed last time out and was running on late into fourth behind Betterthanfederer who has since won again. He draws awkwardly and will need some luck in the run. MY ULTIMATE VICTOR (2) led last time out and set a genuine tempo when being run down late finishing third at this track behind Western Bill and Rock Nien. He should have the gate speed to find a prominent position early in this race and should run well. LULU LUCIFER (1) led two starts ago at Marburg and proved too good for Dual Cam who had the perfect trail leaders back. She draws well in this race but steps up in grade and will likely need a few things to go her way. SELECTIONS: ROCKS OR DIAMONDS (6), FOXFIRE EASTON (5), MY ULTIMATE VICTOR (2), LULU LUCIFER (1) SUGGESTED BET: ROCKS OR DIAMONDS (6) to win.

BRITTS MATE (5) looks the class runner in this field. She wasn’t beaten far into sixth two starts ago at Albion Park in a race taken out by Vincheska. She should be able to press forward and find a prominent position and should run well. STONES (1) has good gate speed and should drive through and lead early in this race. He was able to lead last time out at Marburg and was just run down late by Charlie Chuckles. MULLUM BOY (8) secured a good run last time out and was closing nicely late into third behind Good Word That. He is likely to get a similar run off the speed and should be running into it late. BETTOR DREAM SWEET (3) secured a good run last time out and was finishing it off nicely into third once clear behind Taurus Bromac. SELECTIONS: BRITTS MATE (5), STONES (1), MULLUM BOY (8), BETTOR DREAM SWEET (3) SUGGESTED BET: BRITTS MATE (5) to win.

SOCIAL OUTING (8) ran on nicely two starts ago into second behind Morefuntocome which cleared out to score a dominant win. He draws well in this race to do no work early and settle close in the run and should be hard to hold out. ARKANSAURUS (9) secured a good run off the speed last time out and didn’t finish the race off behind Head Rush. She should get a good run off the speed again in this race and can be running on late. ROCKNROLL TOMBOY (6) went around in a recent trial at Marburg and put in a solid run there when working into it well before finishing a close up third. He draws wide and will need a few things to go his way in the run but looks capable. TINTIN IN LOGAN (7) comes into this race first up from a spell and draws awkwardly inside the back row. Trialled up reasonably in a recent trial behind Frankie Ferocious at Albion Park. SELECTIONS: SOCIAL OUTING (8), ARKANSAURUS (9), ROCKNROLL TOMBOY (6), TINTIN IN LOGAN (7) SUGGESTED BET: SOCIAL OUTING (8) to win. OVERVIEW:AMERICAN MICHI (11) has displayed talent over his lightly raced career, winning on debut at Melton when coming from back in the field and proving too strong. He resumed in a high-quality form race and was very strong to the line last time after missing the start and making up good ground. If he brings his manners, this field looks suitable and, with the draw, the extra distance is in his favour. SASSY GABBY (2) was well supported first-up where she led, handed up and seemed to have every chance. She gets a good map again and with more fitness will take catching. GINGER ELLA (9) has a good record at this track, and although she has an awkward draw, drops back to an easier grade. She’s been racing well against tougher opposition and in her win back in June she beat a couple of handy ones. HANCOCKS HERO (3) is open to improvement returning to the front row and raced tough to win in a lower grade four back, but this doesn’t present much harder. Of the others, POSTER PERFECT (5) was better last time when narrowly beaten, and the stable strikes well at their home track, but the map looks a little tricky. ALPHA CHARLOTTE (6) won her only career start, but I’m not sure she gets the same map and is likely to need this run. SELECTIONS:AMERICAN MICHI (11), SASSY GABBY (2), GINGER ELLA (9), HANCOCKS HERO (3)

OVERVIEW: Very tricky affair, with the majority of these not coming in off good performances at their last start. MYNAMEISRUBY (10) is one of those, finishing last, albeit from a wide draw and up in class. She was a winner prior when she was able to lead from the pole. Her best form is at this track, she gets the best driver, and that’s enough to be in her corner despite the draw. OLLY ODD POTTS (5) can be hard to catch. She was able to go back-to-back in April but hasn’t run a place in eleven starts since. She has good gate speed, and if she can get into a handy position, she’s worth keeping safe if she finds her best. DREAMTIME NALA (8) beat a similar field four runs back but hasn’t delivered the same quality since. She never ran on at all last Wednesday at Melton, but the soft draw here can see her atone. NORTHERN TERROR (7) can run a good race at times, although his last two have been far from ideal. His best is better than most of these, so he warrants consideration despite the wide draw. You could make a case for THE IRISHMAN (2), BERYLS BOOTS (3) and FOUR STARZZ RUBY (4) with the right runs, but again their form is questionable. SELECTIONS:MYNAMEISRUBY (10), OLLY ODD POTTS (5), DREAMTIME NALA (8), NORTHERN TERROR (7)

OVERVIEW:BAY OF FIRES (5) backed up his solid trials, proving most impressive when winning on debut in good time. He showed good gate speed to overcome his main rival in betting and beat the rest by a space. There’s no reason why he can’t cross to the pegs again from a similar draw, and this race doesn’t present as overly strong for him to repeat the dose and continue on his winning way. HEAVENLY FLYER (4) has proven a most consistent filly this campaign, only missing a place once in seven attempts, and was rewarded with victory last time out. She looks to get a nice map, sliding across inside the top pick to find a good position. FULL CRUNCH AHEAD (3) was good in his runs last campaign, but in his trials since he hasn’t appeared to pack the same punch. He could be open to sharp improvement under race conditions. DALLASCOWBOY (8) won on debut in decent fashion and couldn’t overcome a bad draw when resuming this preparation in a dash home. He has a sticky draw to overcome but is worth keeping safe. BACK: BAY OF FIRES (5) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS:BAY OF FIRES (5), HEAVENLY FLYER (4), FULL CRUNCH AHEAD (3), DALLASCOWBOY (8)

OVERVIEW:LOVE WHO (4) was a winner two back when able to lead and take cover, but the time was quite slow. She subsequently stepped out as favourite at Kilmore where she let a fast front line go and worked around to sit outside the speed mid-race, and to be fair, she was a little plain. Grace Bilney has experience on her, which is a plus, and finding a suitable race she can bounce back. MONTANA MUSCLE (5) is second-up here from a break and didn’t have the right set-up to feature last time. He was a winner last preparation at Bendigo, beating a better field, so with added fitness can improve. BETSY ANNE (3) was going better a couple of months back, so it’s hard to know where she’s at, but she gets a soft draw and has better form than most here. ALDEBARAN MARCUS (7) improved at his second start for the new stable, albeit getting a gun run from a soft trailing draw. A repeat of that against this line up gives him minor claims. SELECTIONS:LOVE WHO (4), MONTANA MUSCLE (5), BETSY ANNE (3), ALDEBARAN MARCUS (7)

OVERVIEW: AUSSIE JAY MAC (3) has only had the one career win from 17 attempts, but that’s not a true indication of his ability, often being let down by his manners. He came through the Graduation Series, running second to the very smart The Last Trip two runs back, then got into the right spot in the final, only to race roughly mid-race and throw away his chance. He may be a handful under concession conditions, but his ability is better than most. IAMAWINGATE (1) gets his best draw in a while to get a perfect run, likely behind the leader here from the pole. Even though he rises in ratings, this looks suitable on the form lines he brings into this and he’s a serious winning chance. MONSIEUR FLAMEL (6) is a go-forward type suited over the short trip. He was able to lead from a wide draw last time and improved his form, so even though the map is uncertain he’s heading in the right direction. TALISKER SKIPPER (5) has been much better down in grade his past couple, overcoming back-row draws on those occasions. He can most likely get cover here and be in the mix with the right tempo. BACK: AUSSIE JAY MAC (3) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: AUSSIE JAY MAC (3), IAMAWINGATE (1), MONSIEUR FLAMEL (6), TALISKER SKIPPER (5)

OVERVIEW: ARE WESLEY (3) was shaping up to win a better-quality race at Melton last time out before breaking at about the 300m mark and losing all chance. That followed a strong performance when sitting parked in solid time at Ballarat. The concession claim brings her in well, the map looks favourable, and she looks hard to beat. CLIVES GIRL (2) is always solid in the market, but she just struggles to win and is often in the placings. This race does look to suit again and with the good draw she’s certain to get an economical trip and her chance. SMOKING SHANNON (5) has her first run for the new stable off no trial, but this trainer/driver combination strikes well, so she’s a market watch and must be kept safe. WINGATE GUY (6) gets no favours from the draw but is often thereabouts in this grade. He’ll be giving the others a start, but he’ll be working home well late if they happen to overdo things at the top end. BACK: ARE WESLEY (3)– 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: ARE WESLEY (3), CLIVES GIRL (2), SMOKING SHANNON (5), WINGATE GUY (6)

OVERVIEW:DELIGHTFUL REYNA (5) has shown some positive signs against some smart 2yos in her four-start career, the best of those a second last time out at Melton. She’s mixed her gait at various times and gives away maturity and experience, but from the astute stable she has to be considered. SO SKEPTICAL (2) makes her debut here and local trainer Lisa Pitt has made a habit over the past month of progressing these from the trials to win under race conditions. The most recent trial against more seasoned types was okay, and this looks to be a suitable assignment to kick things off. WAR DAN PHOENIX (3) is on the back-up from Sunday night at Cranbourne. He’s still a maiden in 18 attempts but he’s shown some glimpses that he’s getting closer to a win. He has good gate speed to lob into a nice position. SUMMER KISS (1) is a former Sydneysider whose former stable has no doubt conditioned her well, and although her form doesn’t look flash, it has been in decent 2yo company, so she’s worth keeping safe. BACK: DELIGHTFUL REYNA (5) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: DELIGHTFUL REYNA (5), SO SKEPTICAL (2), WAR DAN PHOENIX (3), SUMMER KISS (1)

OVERVIEW: A 2yo maiden with no exposed form, so we are completely going on what’s been seen at the trials. KONSTAS (1) has shown nice ability in his two outings at the trials, in both taking on older horses. He hasn’t shown brilliant gate speed so may be driven with cover, but the way he’s found the line suggests he can put down sectionals good enough to win this. ALTO CORAGGIO (2) certainly is a good-looking son of Ride High, and from the pole in his trial showed good enough gate speed and tractability. He did have to be pushed to the line. The Lisa Pitt stable is flying at this track and producing several youngsters to win first-up, so on that alone he’s a strong winning chance. IM A ROCKSTAR (3) was in the same trial, settled back in the field and found the line quite well. He’s a stablemate to the top pick, and the stable strikes well, particularly here at their home track. POSTMAN JOEY (5) showed good gate speed in his outing at Melton and was keen to hold the lead there, only knocking up in the last 100m. They seem to be the only winning hopes based on what’s been seen at the trials, and more specifically the winner should come from the top two picks. BACK: KONSTAS (1) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS:KONSTAS (1), ALTO CORAGGIO (2), IM A ROCKSTAR (3), POSTMAN JOEY (5)
